Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised 
Occupants) Act, 1971 were initiated against the 
petitioner. In the said proceedings, the petitioner 
was declared as a person in unauthorised 
occupation of the property in question. He was 
directed to vacate the property and to pay rent/
damages to the tune of Rs.14,22,491.00. An 
Appeal was filed by the petitioner. The appeal has 
been dismissed on 29.03.2023. Hence, the 
present writ petition under Article 227 of the 
Constitution of India.
6. The final hearing in this petition has 
commenced. Arguments of the petitioner are 
being heard. 7. Petitioner’s arguments are still ongoing.
8. List on 04.04.2026 for remaining 
arguments.
9. On 03.12.2024, Mr. D.S. Patni, learned 
Senior Advocate appearing for the respondent 
no.1, given an undertaking before the Coordinate 
Bench that the petitioner shall not be evicted 
from the premises-in-question.
10. On 10.03.2026, Mr. B.P. Nautiyal, learned 
Senior Advocate, submitted before the Coordinate 
Bench that though on 03.12.2024, an 
undertaking was given by the then Senior 
Counsel on behalf of the BHEL that the appellant 
may not be evicted from the premises-in￾question, but, as on date, he is not in position to 
continue such an undertaking.
11. The arguments are ongoing. Therefore, it is 
directed that the petitioner shall not be evicted till 
the next date of listing.
12. It is also made clear that adjournment of 
any kind of the petitioner shall not be entertained 
on the date fixed.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
